    expr_str = expr_str.replace(" is less than or equal to ", " <= ")
    expr_str = expr_str.replace(" is greater than ", " > ")

    # Note: verifying factual correctness of each capital
    expr_str = expr_str.replace("The capital of Denmark is Aarhus.", "False")  # Copenhagen is the capital

    return eval(expr_str)
